gui.magneticraft.guide.title: Magneticraft Guide
guide.magneticraft.computer.language.for: A bounded stack-based Forth core with historical arithmetic, control flow, dictionary, and device words; stacks, dictionary, and per-tick execution are limited.
guide.magneticraft.computer.language.lis: A Lisp layer on the bounded VM with definitions, expressions, environment inspection, and device calls; memory and evaluation budgets prevent unbounded growth.
guide.magneticraft.computer.language.she: A constrained Shell for the virtual floppy and quarry commands; it cannot access the host filesystem, outbound network, or unloaded chunks.
guide.magneticraft.computer.opcode.add: Add register B to register A
guide.magneticraft.computer.opcode.divid: Divide register A by register B
guide.magneticraft.computer.opcode.jump_: Jump to B when register A is zero
guide.magneticraft.computer.opcode.load: Load RAM address B into register A
guide.magneticraft.computer.opcode.mine: Mine in relative direction A and store the result in register B
guide.magneticraft.computer.opcode.modul: Store register A modulo register B
guide.magneticraft.computer.opcode.move: Move in relative direction A and store the result in register B
guide.magneticraft.computer.opcode.multi: Multiply register A by register B
guide.magneticraft.computer.opcode.set: Set register A to immediate B
guide.magneticraft.computer.opcode.set_r: Set redstone output to A and store the result in register B
guide.magneticraft.computer.opcode.store: Store register B at RAM address A
guide.magneticraft.computer.opcode.subtr: Subtract register B from register A
Transfers directionally between adjacent tiers through two isolated terminals; its GUI can reverse safely.
Trips on overload and can be reset from its GUI only after the fault and redstone-forced open are gone.
guide.magneticraft.item.computer.descrip: Runs bounded Forth, Lisp, or Shell programs and reaches the world only through a server-validated device bus.
guide.magneticraft.item.conveyor_belt.de: Moves an internal item payload horizontally with right-click access, corners, and blockage backpressure.
guide.magneticraft.item.copper_wire_coil: Sneak-use a first endpoint, then use an endpoint with the same tier, port type, and dimension; invalid links do not consume the coil.
guide.magneticraft.item.electric_cable.d: Connects adjacent same-tier electrical ports; sustained overload accumulates stress and can burn the cable.
guide.magneticraft.item.electric_chainsa: Rapidly cuts wood, leaves, vines, plants, cactus, and cobwebs.
guide.magneticraft.item.electric_connect: A tiered wall endpoint with 8/16/32-block LV/MV/HV ranges. Only the LV variant exports up to 400 FE/t behind it.
guide.magneticraft.item.electric_drill.d: Mines pickaxe and shovel blocks at diamond tier; without enough energy it falls back to hand speed.
Pushes its user backward after targeting a block within six blocks, or pushes a targeted entity away.
guide.magneticraft.item.electric_pole.de: A five-block tiered overhead endpoint with 16/32/64-block LV/MV/HV ranges. It only links the same tier and never force-loads chunks.
guide.magneticraft.item.electric_pole_tr: Upgrades a complete pole into a two-terminal overhead transformer whose profile fixes tiers, direction, limit, and default 96% efficiency.
Matches a fuse box by tier and 8/16 C/t rating and must be replaced after it blows.
guide.magneticraft.item.electrical_repai: Repairs a faulted machine when every terminal is below 95% nominal voltage; durability is 16.
guide.magneticraft.item.floppy_disk.desc: Stores versioned programs and a virtual filesystem; corrupt, future-version, and read-only preset media fail safely.
guide.magneticraft.item.fuse_box.descrip: Uses a fuse matching line tier and rating; overload blows it and opens the internal edge first.
guide.magneticraft.item.heat_pipe.descri: Connects thermal nodes with environmental heat loss and pauses during chunk unload.
guide.magneticraft.item.heat_sink.descri: Deliberately dissipates thermal-network energy to limit machine and pipe temperatures.
guide.magneticraft.item.inserter_speed_u: Reduces inserter action delay and applies only through its real upgrade slot.
guide.magneticraft.item.inserter_stack_u: Lets an inserter move larger stacks without bypassing destination-capacity checks.
guide.magneticraft.item.insulated_heat_p: A thermal pipe with reduced environmental loss that never force-loads neighboring chunks.
Performs bounded simulate-then-commit transfers between compatible fluid endpoints.
guide.magneticraft.item.low_voltage_batt: A portable 250 kFE cell that charges and discharges in the battery block.
guide.magneticraft.item.medium_voltage_b: A 2.5 MFE portable cell with ten times the low battery's capacity.
guide.magneticraft.item.mining_robot.des: Executes movement, scan, mining, and quarry tasks under permission, energy, range, chunk, and tick budgets.
guide.magneticraft.item.oil_deposit.desc: Stores a finite crude-oil reserve that a pumpjack extracts only while source and structure are loaded and valid.
guide.magneticraft.item.pneumatic_restri: Raises route cost so logistics searches prefer ordinary pneumatic tubes when possible.
guide.magneticraft.item.pneumatic_tube.d: Forms a bounded pneumatic logistics graph whose payloads survive blocked or unloaded targets.
guide.magneticraft.item.tesla_tower.desc: A three-block wireless transmitter. At 60 V or more it transfers up to 500 J per tick within 32 blocks.
guide.magneticraft.item.thermometer.desc: Reads a thermal node's temperature in Celsius with one decimal place.
guide.magneticraft.item.voltmeter.descri: Provides server-authoritative point, network-summary, and fault-locator modes; sneak-use in air to cycle modes.
guide.magneticraft.item.wind_turbine.des: Generates up to 200 J/t. Keep the rotor plane and 16 blocks ahead clear; its scan never loads chunks.
guide.magneticraft.item.wireless_energy_: Receives Tesla-tower power and exports 0-400 FE/t, scaled by voltage, to a Forge Energy device behind it.
guide.magneticraft.item.wrench.descripti: Configures machine, pipe, and network sides; sneak-use selects secondary actions.
guide.magneticraft.machine.airlock.descr: Every 40 ticks, spends electricity across the loaded radius-9 area to maintain boundary bubbles and clear interior water; it decays when undervolted.
guide.magneticraft.machine.battery_box.d: Charges and discharges portable cells through two internal slots and the Magneticraft grid; it exposes no external Forge Energy capability.
guide.magneticraft.machine.brick_furnace: Runs smelting recipes from external heat; recipe changes preserve accumulated progress and the working display lingers briefly.
guide.magneticraft.machine.combustion_ch: Burns internal fuel into heat; use its door to insert fuel directly or change its state.
guide.magneticraft.machine.crushing_tabl: Strike the item on the table with a suitable hammer for the legacy hit count; the server owns results and tool damage.
guide.magneticraft.machine.electric_engi: Exchanges its FE buffer on every side and converts Magneticraft electricity one-way into FE output.
guide.magneticraft.machine.electric_furn: Uses Magneticraft electricity for vanilla smelting recipes; automation sees separate input and output slots, and progress persists.
guide.magneticraft.machine.electric_heat: Converts Magneticraft electricity into heat in 80 J/t steps; below 80 J, conversion stops while stored heat gradually dissipates.
guide.magneticraft.machine.fabricator.de: Records a crafting pattern in ghost slots and reads adjacent inventories; right-click clears the result pattern and left-click requests crafting.
guide.magneticraft.machine.feeding_troug: Every 400 ticks, attempts to feed two breedable animals with wheat, carrots, or wheat seeds.
guide.magneticraft.machine.forge_energy_: Uses an 80 kFE bidirectional buffer on every side and emits heat through its vertical ports.
Bridges Magneticraft joules and Forge Energy at 1 J = 1 FE within its transfer limits.
guide.magneticraft.machine.gasification_: Converts items into gas from data recipes at sufficient temperature, with automated item I/O and fluid output.
guide.magneticraft.machine.infinite_ener: A creative administration device that continuously holds a 125 V source; it has no survival recipe.
guide.magneticraft.machine.inserter.desc: Moves items between adjacent inventories with filter, direction, speed, and stack upgrades.
guide.magneticraft.machine.pneumatic_fil: Constrains pneumatic payloads with ghost samples and operates only on the pneumatic network.
guide.magneticraft.machine.pneumatic_rel: Bridges a pneumatic network and a nine-slot item buffer; its output face rejects ordinary item automation.
guide.magneticraft.machine.pneumatic_tra: Moves matching items between the pneumatic network and an adjacent target using ghost samples.
guide.magneticraft.machine.sluice_box.de: Processes sluice recipes when chained and watered; upstream changes reset the loaded downstream chain.
guide.magneticraft.machine.small_tank.de: Stores one fluid with sided input and output; container interaction is atomic and never consumes a failed container.
Accepts water and exposes steam on every side, converting with heat and retaining the legacy active-output target-side rule.
guide.magneticraft.machine.thermopile.de: Reads a temperature difference to produce Magneticraft electricity through an 80 kJ buffer and 120 V bridge.
guide.magneticraft.machine.water_generat: Its internal infinite water source outputs up to 20 mB/t independently on all six sides without loading chunks.
Provides 27 wooden storage slots with item automation on every side.
guide.magneticraft.multiblock.grinder.de: Runs grinder advanced-processing recipes with persistent inventory, energy, recipe identity, and progress.
guide.magneticraft.multiblock.hydraulic_: Runs matching light, medium, or heavy press recipes with server-validated mode changes.
guide.magneticraft.multiblock.industrial: Burns solid fuel into a large thermal network and preserves fuel while structure or output is blocked.
Performs high-capacity smelting with native electricity and consumes input only when full output can commit.
Converts water and heat into steam while preserving all input, output, and thermal state under backpressure.
guide.magneticraft.multiblock.oil_heater: Uses heat to convert crude oil into heated crude oil and pauses when its output tank lacks capacity.
guide.magneticraft.multiblock.pumpjack.d: Extracts a finite loaded oil deposit without force-loading chunks or allowing a negative reserve.
guide.magneticraft.multiblock.refinery.d: Atomically separates heated crude oil into five role-specific tanks and pauses when any output is blocked.
guide.magneticraft.multiblock.shelving_u: Unlocks storage through owner-protected chest upgrades and hides locked capacity from automation.
guide.magneticraft.multiblock.shipping_c: Provides bulk storage as one item identity and bounded count with side-effect-free simulated insertion and extraction.
guide.magneticraft.multiblock.sieve.desc: Runs sieve advanced-processing recipes and commits input only when the complete result can be accepted.
guide.magneticraft.multiblock.solar_mirr: Contributes concentrated heat to a valid solar tower while daylight and loaded-chunk conditions permit.
guide.magneticraft.multiblock.solar_pane: Generates native electricity under unobstructed daylight and pauses at night or under backpressure.
guide.magneticraft.multiblock.solar_towe: Collects valid mirror contributions and outputs their concentrated heat through the declared thermal port.
guide.magneticraft.multiblock.steam_engi: Consumes steam to generate native electricity and retains input fluid under electrical backpressure.
guide.magneticraft.multiblock.steam_turb: Converts steam into native electricity at a bounded rate and pauses safely while unloaded.
jei.magneticraft.electrical.lines: The tier controls voltage, current rating, color, and connection range; unlike tiers never connect.
jei.magneticraft.electrical.protection: Fuses and breakers must match the line tier and rating, and operate before the protected cable.
jei.magneticraft.electrical.storage: Native electrical storage is tier-limited and does not expose universal FE on arbitrary faces.
jei.magneticraft.electrical.transformers: A transformer profile fixes both tiers, transfer limit, and efficiency while keeping terminals isolated.
jei.magneticraft.electrical.voltmeter: Sneak-use in the air to cycle point probe, network summary, and fault locator modes.
material.magneticraft.tungsten.encyclope: Grants high durability and damage at the cost of mining and attack speed.
material.magneticraft.tungsten.flavor: Dense, stubborn, and built to last.
material.magneticraft.tungsten.ranged: Grants high durability and projectile power at the cost of draw speed and accuracy.
